Recognised for his expressive brushwork and distinctive luminous green palette, Toor brings a contemporary perspective to the traditions of European portraiture. His work is currently the subject of Salman Toor: Someone Like You at London's Courtauld Gallery, his first solo museum exhibition in Europe, running until 10 January 2027. Discover the artist and his growing significance in contemporary art through the latest edition of Orato's Artist of the Week.
